tasks.old_behavior: The parser_start_element callback for the <node> element had a buggy guard: `!(g_slist_length(stack) >= 1 || strcmp(stack->next->data, "node") != 0)`. Since g_slist_length(stack) >= 1 is always TRUE for any non-NULL stack (the stack is always a valid non-empty list from g_markup_parse_context_get_element_stack), the entire expression evaluates to `!(TRUE) = FALSE`, meaning the error path (setting G_MARKUP_ERROR_INVALID_CONTENT) was NEVER reached. Invalid introspection XML with <node> elements nested inside non-<node> parent elements (interface, method, signal, property, arg) was silently accepted and incorrectly parsed.
tasks.new_behavior: The guard is fixed to `stack->next != NULL && strcmp(stack->next->data, "node") != 0`. It properly checks whether there is a parent element (stack->next != NULL) and whether that parent is something other than "node". When a <node> element appears inside a non-<node> parent (e.g., <interface>, <method>, <signal>, <property>, <arg>), the parser now correctly rejects it with G_MARKUP_ERROR_INVALID_CONTENT and the error message '<node> elements can only be top-level or embedded in other <node> elements'.
tasks.compatibility_reason: This is an input contract change on g_dbus_node_info_new_for_xml(), a public GIO API. Previously, certain malformed introspection XML documents (with <node> elements nested inside interface/method/signal/property/arg) were silently accepted and parsed. After the fix, the same XML inputs are rejected with G_MARKUP_ERROR_INVALID_CONTENT. Any application that relied on the buggy behavior by passing such malformed XML to g_dbus_node_info_new_for_xml() will now receive an error instead of successfully parsing the introspection data. In practice, this is unlikely to affect correct D-Bus introspection consumers because such nesting is invalid per the D-Bus specification, but it is a genuine input contract tightening on a public API surface.
tasks.test_recommendation: Run the existing gdbus-introspection test suite to confirm the new test_invalid test passes. The test covers 5 cases of invalid XML that now correctly produce G_MARKUP_ERROR_INVALID_CONTENT. Also verify that g_dbus_node_info_new_for_xml() continues to accept valid introspection XML documents (both top-level <node> and <node> nested inside other <node> elements).
